caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular design divided into two vertical sections, situated in the center of a larger, pale beige background. Both vertical sections are bordered by gold decorative bands featuring a repeating geometric pattern on their inner edges. The left section contains an ornate, symmetrical motif with gold and white floral elements sprouting from a central point, which is adorned with a large, vertically-oriented blue oval flanked by gold scrollwork and ending in a small blue drop shape. The right section displays a smaller, simplified version of the motif, with a similar composition of gold and white flowers above a smaller, downward-pointing blue triangle shape with gold accents and scrolls. The background within both sections is light gray. There is a signature in the lower right area of the beige background outside the main rectangular design.
title: Wall Paper
